name: The Black Box
objectiveText: Take the Corroded Black Box to the Hall of Arms in Ironforge. Corroded Black Box (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body: He doesn't seem to drop the Black Box anymore. I guess they decided to disable that quest for the moment being.
So I killed Zaricotl today, but it didnt drop the item. Quest is probably not in game or something.
Has anyone had the item that starts this quest drop in WoW Classic?
where can we find this blackbox? Is it a random drop or from a specific chest or something?
I'm assuming this is just a faction quest with little value to those who don't need Ironforge faction.
replies: no, its not a repeatable quest and killing an elite over and over would be a weird faction quest. Anyhoo, if you were bored and kill him, you'd get that easy quest for 50s and some exp.

comments.body:
Just soloed him, 54 shaman, dropped Swashbuckler's Eyepatch of the Wolf.

Pretty easy for an elite =)
its dropped by a level 55 elite buzzard at the badlands. name starts with a z forgot what it was called though.
replies: The name is Zaricotl.  If it kills someone, it eats them and becomes satiated, making it a neutral NPC for a while.
